title: The Glacier Bursar's Split
story: Inside a blue ice-vault, Ferrathwaite the Glacier Bursar guards 480 moonstone shards that were frozen out of twelve shivering miners' wages. The bursar sniffs that he keeps 25% as a 'storage fee', then another 60 shards as a 'chipping fee', and the rest may go back to the miners — split evenly, of course.
question: If Ferrathwaite keeps 25% of the 480 shards plus 60 more, and the remaining shards are shared equally among the 12 miners, how many shards does each miner receive?
praise: Taking the percent first was the right opening move — the chipping fee of 60 just needed subtracting before you divided.
hint: Find 25% of 480 first, then take away BOTH fees before you share what's left.
victory: Mr 6 reads the fee list aloud so slowly that Ferrathwaite melts with embarrassment, leaving a puddle, a receipt, and twelve very warm smiles.
imagePrompt: A frost-crusted ledger-keeping ice spirit in a glittering blue glacier vault, shards of moonstone floating in the cold air, a brave numeral 6 knight pointing at the tally.
